CustomField.description: DIR-871: The date/time this decision (Approval/Rejection/Recall) was recorded. Derived from CreatedDate, populated only on those entries so it reads correctly in the Discount History related list.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(RES_Entry_Type__c, "Approval"), ISPICKVAL(RES_Entry_Type__c, "Rejection"), ISPICKVAL(RES_Entry_Type__c, "Recall") ), CreatedDate, null )
CustomField.label: Outcome Date
